summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all three retention policies (max-age, max-total-size, keep-latest-N), error handling, dry-run mode, and CLI integration. Includes boundary condition tests (e.g., artifact exactly at age threshold, keep-latest with mixed-age data), policy interactions, and data validation. Well-organized by feature with clear helper functions (New-TestArtifact) and proper fixture management. Gaps: no tests for zero-byte or extremely-large artifacts, negative WorkflowRunIds, or all three policies combined simultaneously. The multi-layered approach (unit → integration → CLI) and deterministic reference date enhance regression-catching confidence, though some fixture details are not shown. Would effectively catch most regressions despite minor edge-case coverage gaps.
